judgments.reason: The paper describes MNE-BIDS, a standard for organizing electrophysiological data into the BIDS format, which is a general technical specification/tool, not a paper introducing this specific dataset.
judgments.paper_title: MNE-BIDS: Organizing electrophysiological data into the BIDS format and facilitating their analysis

judgments.reason: The paper proposes MEG-BIDS, a principled solution to organize and share MEG data, which is a technical standard/specification used for neuroimaging data, not a description of the specific dataset.
judgments.paper_title: MEG-BIDS, the brain imaging data structure extended to magnetoencephalography
